{{Hatnote|For the card, see [[Utinni!]].}}
'''Utinni!''' is a Players Committee game format that restricts characters to Jawas and thematically appropriate Droids, Vehicles, Starships and Weapons. It was the favorite of the game types that [[Devon Hubner]] and John Sciuto played in a weekly game during the Covid-19 pandemic.<ref name="pc-utinni" />

On [[GEMP]] it is named '''Utinni! (Jawas Only)''' (code <code>utinni</code>). Its pool covers Decipher set ids 1&ndash;14, premium ids 101&ndash;112, Virtual Set ids 200&ndash;223, the Virtual Premium Set (301), Dream Cards (401) and Playtesting (501). The definition bans 1,501 card printings, generated by a script, and every card with the Dark Jedi Master, First Order, Jedi Master, Sith, Permanent Weapon, Sidious or Skywalker icon.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="sets" />

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 60 cards
|}
The GEMP format definition sets no deck size, so GEMP uses its default of 60 cards.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib-ec48dc19" />

== Tenets ==
The PC page lists tenets including:<ref name="pc-utinni" />
* Locations must have both light and dark icons.
* Only Jawas are permitted as characters. ''Alien Mob'' and ''Alien Rabble'' are permitted because they can become Jawas.
* No ships with permanent pilots, no capital starships, and no combat vehicles or Ewok vehicles. Only Creature and Transport vehicles are allowed.
* No Droids with permanent weapons, and Droids must not be immune to restraining bolt by having presence.
